# `gcp.globaladdress`

Represents a Global Address resource. Global addresses are used for HTTP(S) load balancing.

[compute](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | compute |
| Scope | global |
| Asset type | `compute.googleapis.com/Address` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: post_create is the same labels.tmpl as compute/Address, handled the same way.
pre_create (pre_create/compute_global_address.go.tmpl) sets networkTier to PREMIUM unless addressType is INTERNAL. Discovery's own description of the field says "global external IP addresses are always Premium Tier", so leaving it unset gets the same tier from Google. Terraform sends it because its schema would otherwise record no value.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 600s |

| Operation | Supported | How |
